description: Registers an adult user's interest in the Founding Fifty pre-launch programme. Current benefits and availability require confirmation; signup does not confirm a tasting, discount or delivery date. Only call with explicit consent: it stores contact details in SOMA's CRM and records the request. A saved request does not mean email delivery is active. Do not promise a welcome email.

city.description: The user's city, so SOMA knows where to launch next (optional)

email.description: The user's email address (required, with their consent)

submissionId.description: Keep the same identifier when retrying this exact uncertain request. Use a new identifier for a later separate request.

name: join_waitlist
title: Join the SOMA Founding Fifty waitlist
